summary: Configure one evidence-backed timer PWM output and create a duty-cycle module.
requires: A validated board profile whose MCU matches the new project and has a cited timer-clock constraint when a frequency is requested.
One manual-evidenced, available output pin and any load, level, or safety constraint for that pin.
The selected MCU's local CubeMX timer mode/configuration XML for the exact PWM channel, pin signal, prescaler, period, and pulse parameters.
verifications: Verify the generated .ioc selects the planned timer channel and output pin.
Verify generated main.c initializes the intended timer instance and PWM channel parameters.
Compile the project after module integration.
